verdicts.reason: A: the hierarchy is inverted. The quote has shrunk to body size, below the bold yellow attribution, and it wraps to leave 'soon.' orphaned. The logo floats right of centre at the top on no grid, and the lower half is empty circle. B: the quote is set even smaller as one long line, so the attribution clearly dominates. The logo is shrunk to a tiny, hard-to-read mark stuck at the bottom centre, the product is jammed between the two circles, and the bottom third is dead space. A keeps the logo more legible, so it is slightly less bad.
